text.tspan: Part B: local or remote? The kernel decides from 10.20.37.140/26
asks the kernel how it would reach it:
send directly (dev veth0), or via the gateway?
Nothing else is attached to the cable.
A /26 is a block of 64: boundaries at .0 · .64 · .128 · .192.
.200 looks close to .140, but it is in the next block, so it goes via the gateway.
